regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, DOI, and ESI/CCDC footnote
regions.finding: Verified the article title and aggregate current-method claim. The paper mentions ESI and CCDC 2082268, but workspace SI association is unestablished; no SI facts were imported.

regions.region: page 1 introduction and Scheme 1 natural/biologically active structures
regions.finding: Scheme 1 is a contextual panel of cited natural or bioactive products and contains no current-paper reaction arrow, condition, or yield; no experiment record was fabricated.

regions.region: page 1 Sonogashira/concept/current-method discussion continuing to Scheme 2
regions.finding: Three distinct non-row records were classified from the cross-page Scheme 2: cited Sonogashira prior work, a generic conceptual platform, and the current generic oxy-alkynylation class. None is assigned a Table 1/2 row yield.

unresolved: Scheme 1 structures are contextual examples, not current experiments.
Generic Scheme 2 R/Nu/metal labels do not define unique compounds.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Scheme 2a–c
regions.finding: Scheme 2a is cited Sonogashira prior work, 2b is a conceptual coupling platform, and 2c is the current generic method (50 °C, air, 1–2 h, 34 examples); individual experiments are represented separately.

regions.region: page 2 Results and Discussion model-reaction prose
regions.finding: The model 1a/2a run maps to Table 1 entry 1 and is not duplicated. The narrative maps catalyst, solvent, alkyne-loading, atmosphere, and omission effects to the 18 row records.

regions.region: page 2 Table 1 header, entries 1–18, and footnotes a–j
regions.finding: Eighteen independent optimization experiments were retained with exact standard charges, catalyst replacements/omissions, solvent/atmosphere variants, row times, 3aa and 2a' outcomes, iodide byproduct outcomes, and starting-material recoveries. Dashes remain source markers.

regions.region: page 2 scope discussion
regions.finding: The prose maps to the 34 Table 2 oxy-alkynylation rows and the in-situ 3pb-to-5 oxidation shown on page 3. Narrative mentions were linked rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Single-solvent volumes in Table 1 entries 10/11 are not printed.
Most optimization workups/purifications and isolated desired-product masses are absent.
The NMR diyne values are explicitly stated to be imprecise.

regions.region: page 3 Table 2 shared reaction header
regions.finding: Shared 1.0 mmol allenoic acid, 1.3 mmol terminal alkyne, [Cp*RhCl2]2/CuI/i-Pr2NH, DME/toluene, 50 °C, air, and 100 mL Schlenk conditions were applied only to their own rows, with footnote overrides retained.

regions.region: page 3 Scope of Terminal Alkynes, 3aa–(S)-3as
regions.finding: Nineteen distinct displayed scope experiments were recorded row by row with individual times/yields. Footnotes for 3ac, 3ad, 3an and byproduct outcomes were structured rather than left in notes.

regions.region: page 3 Scope of Allenoic Acids, 3ba–3ma
regions.finding: Twelve distinct 2a/allenoic-acid experiments were retained with row times/yields. The 3fa diyne footnote and 3ma CCDC characterization were linked to their records.

regions.region: page 3 trisubstituted-allenoic-acid rows 3nh/3ob/3ph and in-situ 3pb-to-5 arrow
regions.finding: Three distinct lower-yield scope rows retain footnote catalyst/solvent/scale overrides and product-specific lactone side outcomes. The separate 1p/2b sequence forms 3pb in situ and oxidizes it by air to 5 (35%, 6 h); no isolated 3pb yield was invented.

regions.region: page 3 footnotes a–j
regions.finding: All explicit added/overridden solvents, catalyst loadings, scale, vessel, time, byproducts, NMR yields, isolated yields, and recoveries were assigned to their matching rows.

unresolved: Complex scope structures remain source-labeled candidates; many have null SMILES and all remain unverified.
Workups, purifications, and product masses are absent on pages 1–6.
For footnote-j scale-up, unsupported scaled absolute charges were not inferred.

regions.region: page 4 left column Scheme 3 gram-scale 3ai and synthetic applications
regions.finding: Separate records retain gram-scale 3ai, aerobic oxidation to 6, hydroboration to (E)-7, and cross-coupling to (E)-8. The 52% stage yield and 39% overall yield remain distinct; the iron-nitrate hydrate text/caption conflict is preserved.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left appenolide route in Scheme 3
regions.finding: Alkylation 9+10→11, hydrolysis/decarboxylation 11→2t, key 1b+2t→3bt, two-step 3bt→appenolide A, and Lindlar 3bt→(Z)-appenolide A are separate records. Low-temperature, warming, high-temperature, and second-step holds are ordered separately.

regions.region: page 4 upper-right Scheme 4 equations 1–5
regions.finding: Five distinct mechanistic controls were retained: no terminal alkyne, CuBr substitution, compound-4 intermediate test, stoichiometric copper butylacetylide, and catalytic copper butylacetylide with 2j. Non-detections, recovery, and two-product yields remain product-specific.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right proposed mechanism discussion
regions.finding: Paths A/B and the beginning of path C map to one proposed-mechanism record; Int I–VII are not treated as preparations.

unresolved: Several Scheme 3/4 arrows omit scale, workup, purification, isolated mass, or yield basis.
Scheme 3 prose and caption disagree on the iron-nitrate hydrate formula.
The alkylation heating and appenolide hydrosilylation warming-transition times are not reported.

regions.region: page 5 left-column Scheme 5 and path-C continuation
regions.finding: Completes the proposed Rh/Cu paths A–C through Int I–VII. This is one mechanism record and supplies no independent experimental yields for intermediates.

regions.region: page 5 conclusions, author contributions, conflicts, and acknowledgments
regions.finding: Conclusions add no experiment. The acknowledgment says Yibo Yu reproduced Table 2 results 3ai, 3ao, and 3ia; without independent run details this is provenance on those existing rows, not duplicate experiments.
